universe.definition: JRA flat, field_size>=12, 3-win class or higher, 2024-2026; obstacle races excluded using the audited 52-race exclusion universe

replay.ability: Production Ability v3 coefficients with documented opponent-strength median fallback; strict-prior history only
replay.queue: Production validated_queue_model_v1 formula; strict-prior history only
replay.note: M3 replay closely reproduces the stored production validation overlap figures (2024 0.3175, 2025 0.301902, 2026 0.298541), which is an internal reproduction check.

diagnostic_first_mismatch.stage: Queue predicted materially farther back than actual early position
Remaining-600 predicted materially farther back than actual -3F position
M3 finish conversion left horse outside top 3

important_architecture_note: Ability and validated queue do not feed the production M3 score directly. The first-mismatch table is a diagnostic trace, not a literal causal pipeline.

m3_counterfactual_decomposition.interpretation: The larger uncertainty is the remaining-600-to-finish closing-strength forecast, not the remaining-600 position forecast. These are oracle diagnostics, not deployable predictors.

exploratory_fixed5_comparison.challenger: M3 Top3 + best 2 Ability horses outside M3 Top3
exploratory_fixed5_comparison.warning: This rescue rule was identified after inspecting the 2024-2026 audit and must not be promoted to probability or betting logic without a new prospective/future holdout.

rescue_observation.interpretation: Ability and M3 contain complementary information; a strong Ability horse should not be visually treated as disproven merely because M3 ranks it below third.

deployment_decision.recommended_ui_only_change: Optionally expose an Ability rescue/watch label for strong-Ability horses that M3 demotes, clearly marked non-scoring and prospective-validation pending.
